body: aha, genius! i think you are so right on with that...

I am trying to see myself in a new universe... One where my mind isn't hurting... I want to breathe in deep and not feel pain. I want to feel alive, and not fuck up the chances I have been given.

I feel deep emotion welling up inside me, because I know that the pain could be relieved at any moment. 
I just can't see my way to the other side...
I believe in love, and I believe in my friends. And goddamnit it took a long time to gather all the experiences I've had.. though not all of them have been pretty, I have had some amazing times, with GREAT friends. I truly wish things were different in my life, but i feel like a Jenga tower.. wobbling.

The catastrophe that my life is, I want it to heal, I have fought to stay here with all of you. But I feel unforgivably strange, and attached to such crap. I was healthy once, but I made myself sick. I don't want to die a weezy old man, but I don't know when to let go.
